blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—With Letran down a man, Aaron Buensalida stepped up to the plate to help his team in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament at San Juan Arena on Friday. The Knights played without their main big man, Kevin Santos, who served a one-game suspension after being ejected in their last game. Fortunately, Buensalida was more than ready to deliver what was needed of him. “Aaron really needed this to build his confidence,” coach Allen Ricardo said after Letran’s 91-89 win over San Sebastian. “He had great numbers, there are times that when Aaron’s in the game, it’s close but that […]...
